verses.text: For the one directing. A Maskil of David, in the coming of Doeg the Edomite, when he announced to Saul and said to him, “David has gone to the house of Ahimelech.” Why do you boast in evil, O mighty man? The loving devotion of God [is] all the day.

verses.text: Your tongue devises destruction, like a sharp razor working deceit.

segments.text: Your tongue devises destruction, like a sharp razor working deceit.

verses.text: You love evil more than good, lying more than speaking righteousness. Selah

segments.text: You love evil more than good, lying more than speaking righteousness. Selah

verses.text: You love all devouring words, O tongue of deceit!

segments.text: You love all devouring words, O tongue of deceit!

verses.text: Even God will tear you down forever; He will take you up and pluck you out of the tent and uproot you from the land of the living. Selah

verses.text: and the righteous will see and fear, and they shall laugh at him:

segments.text: and the righteous will see and fear, and they shall laugh at him:

verses.text: “Behold the man who did not set God [as] his refuge, and [who] trusted in the abundance of his wealth, [and] took strength by destruction.”

segments.text: “Behold the man who did not set God [as] his refuge, and [who] trusted in the abundance of his wealth, [and] took strength by destruction.”

verses.text: And I [am] green, like an olive tree in the house of God; I trust in the loving devotion of God forever and ever.

segments.text: And I [am] green, like an olive tree in the house of God; I trust in the loving devotion of God forever and ever.

verses.text: I will confess You forever, because You have done [it]. And I will call on Your name, for [it is] good before of Your holy ones.
